items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: John Tumino was like a co-owner, with McShann, of the band. And he was our booking agent.

ctx.x: back. No -- no, I'm ahead of myself. We got a guy called Lester, something, out of Ernie Fields' band, and Earl Jackson. And it was then that McShann began organizing, bringing in the big band. John Tumino (PHONE) had leased --
Tumino now was what? The owner of Martin's?
No, John Tumino was like a co-owner, with McShann, of the band. And he was our booking agent.
